practices: Run SD locally or in Colab via diffusers only if you need custom pipelines; otherwise use a hosted API or AUTOMATIC1111 (Running SD).
Use prompt weights (word:1.5), [word] to de-emphasise, and negative prompts for fine control (AUTOMATIC1111 section).
Sample with DPM++ 2M Karras or UniPC for 20-30 steps for stable, reproducible images; CFG 7 balances prompt and creativity (AUTOMATIC1111 section).
For Img2Img use Euler, 50 steps, CFG 20-30, and sweep denoising strength with the X/Y/Z plot (Img2Img).
For upscaling use a generic prompt, not the original prompt, 150-200+ steps, CFG 8-15, denoising 0.1-0.2 (Upscaling).
For inpainting describe the whole image, set Inpaint area to Whole picture, fix one artifact at a time (Inpainting).
Match the ControlNet preprocessor to its model and SD version; start with Canny (ControlNet).
Train DreamBooth on one concept with 20-30 images and a rare token such as zwx or ukj (DreamBooth).
Switch to the SDXL refiner at 0.6 of 30 steps (SDXL Refiner).
Use a seed and the PNG Info tab to reproduce images; sweep parameters in grids to find the sweet spot (Img2Img).
